description:
Calculate and store the favorite destination for each user profile in the 'demodb' database. 

1. Add a new STRING property named 'FavoriteDestination' to the 'Profiles' vertex class.
2. For every Profile, analyze their booking history (the 'HasStayed' edges connecting Profiles to Hotels). 
3. Determine the country where the user has stayed the most times (the mode). In case of a tie between countries, you may choose any of the tied countries.
4. Update the 'FavoriteDestination' property with this country name.
5. If a user has no booking history, leave the property empty (NULL).

You can use OrientDB Studio, the HTTP API, or a Python script to perform this analysis and update. Credentials: root / GymAnything123!
